author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: A page before the first opens the first page of owners
summary: The owner listing treats any requested page below the first as the first page and answers with the ordinary listing, instead of the error page.
acceptance_criteria: given a request for a page below the first, when the owner list is opened, then the first page of owners is shown as an ordinary listing
given a request for a page below the first, when the listing is shown, then it reports the first page as the one being viewed
given a page below the first and no last name searched for, when the list is opened, then the first page of all owners is shown
given a page below the first and a last name searched for, when the list is opened, then the first page of the matches is shown
given a negative page number, when the owner list is opened, then the first page is shown, exactly as the page before the first is
non_goals: the veterinarian directory's handling of a page before the first — the report named only the owner listing; recorded as an open question in docs/prd.md
a page number beyond the last page, on either listing — recorded as an open question in docs/prd.md
a page value that is not a number at all
notes: Owner listing paging is stated by REQ-OWN-002; this requirement adds only the below-first-page behavior, annotated inline in the Owner records section of docs/prd.md. No Non-Goals row changed, so no scope_overrides. The intake record (line 1) carries the request and no further decisions, so scope is bounded by the reported behavior: owner listing, page below one, HTTP 200 ordinary listing. Two questions the slice does not depend on were left open rather than decided.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Durable memory already carries this shape unchanged. The owner listing's paging lives entirely inside OwnerController's private pagination helpers (docs/system-design.md#contracts, OwnerController row; #constants records the page size as a controller-local variable). The defect is request adaptation, not domain logic: OwnerController.java:135 builds PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize), which rejects a zero-based index below zero and surfaces as the error page. Clamping the requested page to the first page is the same class of request normalization the method already performs for a null last name (OwnerController.java:99-101), so architecture-principles.md's Web controller row still holds and no new business rule enters the controller. No new type, package, or pattern; no ADR. Basis: grep over the owner and vet controllers (no IDE oracle connected in this dispatch, so this resolution is the weaker text-match basis rather than a symbol lookup).
integration_points: GET /owners request binding: the page request parameter (defaultValue 1) reaches processFindForm and flows to two places — findPaginatedForOwnersLastName for the repository query and addPaginationModel for the currentPage model attribute
owners/ownersList view reads currentPage and totalPages; no template change is needed once the model carries the normalized page

patterns.description: existing request-normalization pattern in the same method: a missing last name becomes the broadest search before any query is built
pagination helper translating the one-based page parameter to a zero-based PageRequest; the clamp belongs on the value before it reaches this translation

risks.risk: Normalizing inside findPaginatedForOwnersLastName alone would satisfy the listing criterion but leave addPaginationModel reporting the raw page, failing the acceptance criterion that the listing reports the first page as the one being viewed
risks.mitigation: Normalize once at the top of processFindForm and pass the normalized value to both helpers

risks.risk: VetController.java:61 carries the identical zero-based translation, which invites a shared helper or a parallel fix; both are out of this slice's scope and the veterinarian listing's behavior is an open question in docs/prd.md
risks.mitigation: Keep the two controllers' pagination helpers independent, as docs/system-design.md#constants records them today; leave the vet route untouched

notes: Five-signal foundational check: no signal trips — system-design.md is populated and partly confirmed, ADRs record the language, framework, and package organization, the ubiquitous language is written and confirmed, paging is an existing recorded concern, and no new bounded context appears. No design-doc-autofix records exist in the log, so the autofix audit is skipped. One docs edit landed for the contracts-sync gate: the OwnerController row in docs/system-design.md#contracts now carries REQ-OWNERSPAGEPARAM-001 and names the normalization. No Known Defects row was added for the veterinarian listing — that behavior is undecided in docs/prd.md, not a confirmed defect.

author: feature-implementer
summary: GET /owners now normalizes a requested page below the first to the first page. OwnerController.processFindForm clamps the one-based page parameter once (Math.max(page, FIRST_PAGE)) before it reaches either helper, so both the repository query and the currentPage model attribute see the clamped value; PageRequest.of no longer receives a negative index and the listing answers 200 with owners/ownersList instead of the error page. Two TDD cycles: cycle 1 red reproduced the report (IllegalArgumentException out of PageRequest.of) for page=0 with no last name and drove the clamp; cycle 2 added the search and negative-page cases, which passed on the cycle-1 clamp and pin it against a narrower future fix. Four new tests in OwnerControllerTests, named as the prd-entry pinned them; 19 tests in that class, 0 failures. VetController's identical translation was left untouched per the design-block's second risk and the declared non-goal. No production change outside OwnerController, no configuration change, no docs edit.

author: change-grader
summary: clamp a below-first owner-listing page to the first page

blast_radius.note: Ten production lines inside one method of one controller in a single module, plus two prose docs; no sensitive paths, no template, repository, or vet-controller reach, and the paired VetController carrying the identical zero-based translation was deliberately left untouched.

semantic_surprise.note: Reading all four production hunks, the change is exactly what it advertises: a Math.max clamp against the first page computed once and threaded to both the repository query and the currentPage model attribute, so a page of one or more behaves identically and only the previously-throwing negative-index path changes.

test_adequacy.note: The four new tests assert real outcomes rather than restating the implementation - an ArgumentCaptor reads the zero-based page index the controller actually asked the repository for, and a model assertion pins the reported current page - and each would fail against the unclamped code, which threw on a negative page index; the searched path, the unsearched path, and a negative page are all covered.

reviewer_hedging.note: Two of the three planned reviewers approved with residue parked rather than resolved: code-quality flags that the request-parameter default of one and the FIRST_PAGE constant are two independent literals needing hand-synchronization, and test-review files a clarify finding aimed at the system-design-expert that the clamp is a framework-free rule tested only through MockMvc because the design decision keeps it inline in a private method; the silent security-reviewer is expected, since the risk-proportional plan never dispatched it.

scope_deviation.note: Zero design revisions, consultations, and build retries; the diff matches the requirement's declared file targets plus the two docs the design-block named, and the two adjacent questions the fix invites - the vet directory and a page beyond the last - were recorded as open questions instead of quietly decided.
